scripts.prepare:web: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force www | Out-Null; Copy-Item index.html,styles.css,app.js,manifest.webmanifest,icon.svg,service-worker.js www -Force"
scripts.sync:android: npm run prepare:web && cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
